personal_statement: As a seasoned Senior Applied AI and ML Engineer with deep proficiency in machine learning, statistical modelling, uncertainty quantification, and data-driven decision support, I have successfully applied my expertise across various domains. With a strong background in designing, implementing, and evaluating advanced machine learning systems, including graph-based feature extraction, time-series modelling, probabilistic deep learning, and scalable benchmarking, I bring both scientific rigour and practical delivery focus to complex problems. My experience fine-tuning and deploying large pre-trained and foundation models, including language and scientific models, along with my proven track record of extracting insights from large and noisy datasets, makes me an ideal candidate for this role. With a strong understanding of model evaluation, including benchmarking, cross-validation, and performance across data distributions, I am confident in my ability to drive engineering excellence in complex environments. Through my experience working on projects such as fraud detection, expected credit loss analysis, structural health monitoring, and compliance analytics, I have honed my skills in framing analytical problems, sourcing and transforming the right data, building and evaluating models, quantifying uncertainty, and explaining results clearly to stakeholders. My unique blend of research depth, production focus, and technical communication skills makes me an excellent fit for this Senior Expert position.
